description: Polyphonic organ voice after the Hammond tone-wheel organs: nine drawbars mixing fixed sine partials, percussion, key click and its own envelopes, so it needs no VCA or filter after it

params.text: Sets the level of the 16' sine, an octave below the fundamental, which sounds C3 when the fundamental is C4; a step of the drawbar is about 3dB
Sets the level of the 5 1/3' sine, a fifth above the fundamental, which sounds G4 when the fundamental is C4; a step of the drawbar is about 3dB
Sets the level of the 8' sine, the fundamental itself at C4; a step of the drawbar is about 3dB
Sets the level of the 4' sine, the second harmonic, which sounds C5 when the fundamental is C4; a step of the drawbar is about 3dB
Sets the level of the 2 2/3' sine, the third harmonic, which sounds G5 when the fundamental is C4; a step of the drawbar is about 3dB
Sets the level of the 2' sine, the fourth harmonic, which sounds C6 when the fundamental is C4; a step of the drawbar is about 3dB
Sets the level of the 1 3/5' sine, the fifth harmonic, which sounds E6 when the fundamental is C4; a step of the drawbar is about 3dB
Sets the level of the 1 1/3' sine, the sixth harmonic, which sounds G6 when the fundamental is C4; a step of the drawbar is about 3dB
Sets the level of the 1' sine, the eighth harmonic, which sounds C7 when the fundamental is C4; a step of the drawbar is about 3dB, despite the manual calling it the fifth harmonic
Sets how much third-harmonic percussion is added at the start of a note, a fast decaying tone a fifth and an octave above the fundamental
Sets how much second-harmonic percussion is added at the start of a note, a fast decaying tone an octave above the fundamental
Picks the decay time of the percussion tones, fast or slow
Turns key click on, which gates the sines on and off as fast as possible so the switching is audible; with it off the envelopes are slowed enough to stop the click
Sets the attack time of the note envelopes, which a Hammond does not have and which stands in for a swell pedal
Sets the release time of the note envelopes, which a Hammond does not have and which stands in for a swell pedal

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of each voice, a volt per octave; the number of channels on this cable sets how many voices play, and one voice plays with nothing patched
Opens the envelope for each voice while its gate is high; with nothing patched here every voice sounds continuously, which turns the module into a VCO
Multiplies the level of that drawbar, so 0V silences it whatever the drawbar is set to and a drawbar at zero stays silent whatever the voltage; the same voltage applies to every voice
Lengthens the attack of the note envelopes, added to the A knob so that the full range is reachable at any knob setting; the same voltage applies to every voice
Lengthens the release of the note envelopes, added to the R knob so that the full range is reachable at any knob setting; the same voltage applies to every voice

outputs.text: The organ voice, polyphonic with one channel per voice

notes: with nothing patched at the Gate input every voice sounds continuously and the percussion never fires, so the module runs as a VCO and needs volume and timbre control after it
menu: Preset — the submenu Rack puts on every module, listing the presets shipped here: basics are pop, rock and jazz starting points, songs approximate Hammond recordings
